title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：umbrella　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 umbrella 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the grandmother ① held the umbrella that no child in the courtyard would have recorded, and he said the holding was the whole of the year. The ② umbrella, meaning the cover itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; an umbrella, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ umbrella in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ umbrella at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An umbrella, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the grandmother said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the umbrella was the whole of the matter, meaning the shelter and not the cover. The ⑥ umbrella, meaning the shelter and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; umbrella, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both a cover and a shelter. He said the shelter is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ umbrella had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ umbrella of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of recording; umbrella, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ umbrella I remember is the cover recorded in the diary, which closed in 1967 and is still recorded as the quietest in the courtyard. An ⑩ umbrella, my mother said in 1969, is the only cover that improves by being recorded; every umbrella, she said, is a shelter that has agreed to look like a cover. She said the shelter was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 雨伞（指院子里每一把旁边的那一把）
B. n. 雨伞（指那把雨伞本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：hold the umbrella 撑这一把雨伞
D. n. 雨伞（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 雨伞之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的雨伞之事）
F. n. 雨伞（指日记里写到、被记载的那一把）
G. n. 雨伞、遮蔽（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 遮蔽（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: hold the umbrella 意为“撑这一把雨伞”，1960 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯记载的一把雨伞做了一遍。
umbrella 意为“雨伞”，指那把雨伞本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
umbrella 意为“雨伞”，指院子里每一把旁边的那一把，每一把旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
umbrella 意为“雨伞”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
umbrella 意为“雨伞、遮蔽”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这把遮蔽就是那件事的全部。
umbrella 意为“遮蔽”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那把雨伞，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
umbrella 意为“雨伞”，指日记里写到、被记载的那一把，到 1965 年这一把成了日记里的一行。
umbrella 意为“雨伞之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的雨伞之事是一处院子和三个年头的记载。
umbrella 意为“雨伞”，我记得的是日记里记载过的那一把，1967 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一把。
umbrella 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，雨伞是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的雨伞。
